sentences.text_target: The winter cold brings a lot of snow outside.
sentences.phonetic: ðə wɪntər koʊld brɪŋz ə lɑt əv snoʊ aʊtsaɪd.
sentences.text_native: Le froid de l'hiver apporte beaucoup de neige dehors.

sentences.text_target: David stays inside his warm house.
sentences.phonetic: ˈdeɪvɪd steɪz ɪnˈsaɪd hɪz wɔrm haʊs.
sentences.text_native: David reste à l'intérieur de sa maison bien chauffée.

sentences.text_target: Suddenly, he feels a bad pain in his throat.
sentences.phonetic: ˈsʌdənli, hi filz ə bæd peɪn ɪn hɪz θroʊt.
sentences.text_native: Soudain, il ressent une vive douleur dans la gorge.

sentences.text_target: He starts to cough and has a mild fever.
sentences.phonetic: hi stɑrts tu kɑf ənd hæz ə maɪld ˈfivər.
sentences.text_native: Il commence à tousser et a une légère fièvre.

sentences.text_target: His head hurts and his eyes feel very heavy.
sentences.phonetic: hɪz hɛd hɜrts ənd hɪz aɪz fil ˈvɛri ˈhɛvi.
sentences.text_native: Il a mal à la tête et ses yeux lui semblent très lourds.

sentences.text_target: He is very tired and needs to sit on the sofa.
sentences.phonetic: hi ɪz ˈvɛri ˈtaɪərd ənd nidz tu sɪt ɑn ðə ˈsoʊfə.
sentences.text_native: Il est très fatigué et a besoin de s'asseoir sur le canapé.

sentences.text_target: His wife brings a warm cup of tea to the living room.
sentences.phonetic: hɪz waɪf brɪŋz ə wɔrm kʌp əv ti tu ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ rum.
sentences.text_native: Sa femme apporte une tasse de thé chaud au salon.

sentences.text_target: She adds some honey and lemon to the liquid.
sentences.phonetic: ʃi ædz sʌm ˈhʌni ənd ˈlɛmən tu ðə ˈlɪkwɪd.
sentences.text_native: Elle ajoute un peu de miel et de citron au breuvage.

sentences.text_target: David drinks the hot tea slowly from the glass.
sentences.phonetic: ˈdeɪvɪd drɪŋks ðə hɑt ti ˈsloʊli frʌm ðə glæs.
sentences.text_native: David boit lentement son thé chaud dans le verre.

sentences.text_target: After that, he checks his temperature with a digital thermometer.
sentences.phonetic: ˈæftər ðæt, hi tʃɛks hɪz ˈtɛmpərətʃər wɪð ə ˈdɪdʒɪtəl θərˈmɑmətər.
sentences.text_native: Après cela, il prend sa température avec un thermomètre numérique.

sentences.text_target: The thermometer shows that he is quite sick.
sentences.phonetic: ðə θərˈmɑmətər ʃoʊz ðæt hi ɪz kwaɪt sɪk.
sentences.text_native: Le thermomètre indique qu'il est assez malade.

sentences.text_target: He walks to the kitchen counter to find some medicine.
sentences.phonetic: hi wɔks tu ðə ˈkɪtʃən ˈkaʊntər tu faɪnd sʌm ˈmɛdəsən.
sentences.text_native: Il se dirige vers le comptoir de la cuisine pour trouver des médicaments.

sentences.text_target: He finds a box of cough syrup in the cupboard.
sentences.phonetic: hi faɪndz ə bɑks əv kɑf ˈsɪrəp ɪn ðə ˈkʌbərd.
sentences.text_native: Il trouve une boîte de sirop contre la toux dans le placard.

sentences.text_target: He opens the package and takes out the plastic bottle.
sentences.phonetic: hi ˈoʊpənz ðə ˈpækɪdʒ ənd teɪks aʊt ðə ˈplæstɪk ˈbɑtəl.
sentences.text_native: Il ouvre l'emballage et sort la bouteille en plastique.

sentences.text_target: He reads the instructions on the paper label carefully.
sentences.phonetic: hi ridz ðə ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz ɑn ðə ˈpeɪpər ˈleɪbəl ˈkɛrfəli.
sentences.text_native: Il lit attentivement les instructions sur l'étiquette en papier.

sentences.text_target: He wants to follow every rule for his safe recovery.
sentences.phonetic: hi wɑnts tu ˈfɑloʊ ˈɛvəri rul fɔr hɪz seɪf rɪˈkʌvəri.
sentences.text_native: Il veut suivre toutes les consignes pour guérir en toute sécurité.

sentences.text_target: The label explains the exact dose for an adult.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ˈleɪbəl ɪkˈspleɪnz ði ɪgˈzækt doʊs fɔr ən əˈdʌlt.
sentences.text_native: L'étiquette indique la dose exacte pour un adulte.

sentences.text_target: He needs to measure the liquid in a small cap.
sentences.phonetic: hi nidz tu ˈmɛʒər ðə ˈlɪkwɪd ɪn ə smɔl kæp.
sentences.text_native: Il doit mesurer le liquide dans un petit bouchon.

sentences.text_target: He pours the sweet syrup into the small plastic cap.
sentences.phonetic: hi pɔrz ðə swit ˈsɪrəp ˈɪntu ðə smɔl ˈplæstɪk kæp.
sentences.text_native: Il verse le sirop sucré dans le petit bouchon en plastique.

sentences.text_target: The correct dose is one small spoon every eight hours.
sentences.phonetic: ðə kəˈrɛkt doʊs ɪz wʌn smɔl spun ˈɛvəri eɪt ˈaʊərz.
sentences.text_native: La bonne dose est d'une petite cuillère toutes les huit heures.

sentences.text_target: David swallows the medicine quickly with some fresh water.
sentences.phonetic: ˈdeɪvɪd ˈswɑloʊz ðə ˈmɛdəsən ˈkwɪkli wɪð sʌm frɛʃ ˈwɔtər.
sentences.text_native: David avale rapidement le médicament avec un peu d'eau fraîche.

sentences.text_target: He puts the bottle back inside the small box.
sentences.phonetic: hi pʊts ðə ˈbɑtəl bæk ɪnˈsaɪd ðə smɔl bɑks.
sentences.text_native: Il remet la bouteille dans la petite boîte.

sentences.text_target: His stomach feels a bit sensitive after the food he ate.
sentences.phonetic: hɪz ˈstʌmək filz ə bɪt ˈsɛnsətɪv ˈæftər ðə fud hi eɪt.
sentences.text_native: Son estomac est un peu sensible après ce qu'il a mangé.

sentences.text_target: He decides to go back to his comfortable bed.
sentences.phonetic: hi dɪˈsaɪdz tu goʊ bæk tu hɪz ˈkʌmfərtəbəl bɛd.
sentences.text_native: Il décide de retourner dans son lit confortable.

sentences.text_target: His wife puts a warm blanket over his weak body.
sentences.phonetic: hɪz waɪf pʊts ə wɔrm ˈblæŋkət ˈoʊvər hɪz wik ˈbɑdi.
sentences.text_native: Sa femme le recouvre d'une couverture chaude pour réchauffer son corps affaibli.

sentences.text_target: He closes his eyes and tries to get some sleep.
sentences.phonetic: hi ˈkloʊzɪz hɪz aɪz ənd traɪz tu gɛt sʌm slip.
sentences.text_native: Il ferme les yeux et essaie de trouver le sommeil.

sentences.text_target: The night passes slowly while he takes good rest.
sentences.phonetic: ðə naɪt ˈpæsəz ˈsloʊli waɪl hi teɪks gʊd rɛst.
sentences.text_native: La nuit passe lentement alors qu'il se repose profondément.

sentences.text_target: Tomorrow morning, he will phone the doctor if he feels worse.
sentences.phonetic: təˈmɑroʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ, hi wɪl foʊn ðə ˈdɑktər ɪf hi filz wɜrs.
sentences.text_native: Demain matin, il appellera le médecin s'il se sent plus mal.

sentences.text_target: Right now, breathing becomes a little more easy for him.
sentences.phonetic: raɪt naʊ, ˈbriðɪŋ bɪˈkʌmz ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr ˈizi fɔr hɪm.
sentences.text_native: Pour l'instant, il lui est un peu plus facile de respirer.

sentences.text_target: He hopes to feel much better by the next day.
sentences.phonetic: hi hoʊps tu fil mʌtʃ ˈbɛtər baɪ ðə nɛkst deɪ.
sentences.text_native: Il espère se sentir beaucoup mieux dès le lendemain.
